req.title: Location header on create
req.statement: The system shall set Location: /players/{new_id} on the 201 Created response.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-027 requires that POST /players/ returns HTTP 201 and sets a Location header pointing to /players/squadnumber/{squad_number} (as implemented in the source). Tests cover: (1) positive EP — valid new player yields 201 + correct Location header value; (2) negative NEG — duplicate squad_number yields 409 and no Location header; (3) boundary BVA — squad_number at boundary value (0, which is the lowest integer boundary near valid domain) to probe off-by-one mutations; (4) DT — missing required field yields 422 and no Location header; (5) STC — verifying Location header value exactly matches the squad_number from the response body, catching constant/string mutations in the header template.

tests.name: test_post_player_returns_201_with_location_header
preconditions: Database contains 26 pre-loaded players with squad numbers 1-26
Squad number 99 does not exist in the database
actions: POST /players/ with a valid payload using squad_number=99
trace: R-PLAYER-027: Location header set on 201 Created
tests.executable:
import os, tempfile, pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=True)

def test_post_player_returns_201_with_location_header():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 99,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    assert "location" in {k.lower() for k in r.headers}
    location = r.headers.get("location") or r.headers.get("Location")
    assert location == "/players/squadnumber/99"
    body = r.json()
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert "id" in body

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=True)

def test_post_player_location_header_matches_squad_number_in_body():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "State",
        "lastName": "Transition",
        "squadNumber": 50,
        "position": "Left-Back",
        "team": "Juventus",
        "league": "Serie A"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    location = r.headers.get("location") or r.headers.get("Location")
    body = r.json()
    squad_number = body["squadNumber"]
    assert squad_number == 50
    expected_location = f"/players/squadnumber/{squad_number}"
    assert location == expected_location
    assert location == "/players/squadnumber/50"

expected: Location header does not use /players/{uuid} pattern
trace: R-PLAYER-027: Location path must use squadnumber sub-resource, not UUID
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=True)

def test_post_player_location_header_prefix_is_players_squadnumber():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Prefix",
        "lastName": "Check",
        "squadNumber": 75,
        "position": "Right Winger"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    location = r.headers.get("location") or r.headers.get("Location")
    assert location is not None
    assert location.startswith("/players/squadnumber/")
    assert location == "/players/squadnumber/75"
    parts = location.split("/")
    assert parts == ["", "players", "squadnumber", "75"]
